artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan pinning three advisory repo-health signals (README verification dates, C20 citation tiers, C16 env_linter roots) to committed keyed ratchet baselines with gates that fail on an increase, each falsified by a seeded finding.

memory_candidates.content: When making an advisory repo-health signal enforceable, do not reuse an existing grandfathering file whose regeneration path is wholesale-destructive and whose current content backs a live gate. BimodalLogic's scripts/nolints.json is read root-independently by Batteries' runLinter and backs CI's non-continue-on-error 'lake lint' step; 'runLinter --update' rewrites it keeping only findings for the roots named on that invocation (observed collapse 914 -> 237 lines). Extending it to widen a signal's scope has two further costs beyond the regeneration hazard: grandfathering makes the findings stop being reported, so the count the task exists to pin reads zero and the drift signal disappears; and its [linterClass, declName] key carries no root component, so it cannot express a per-root sum. Prefer a NEW keyed baseline file in the warning-budget.txt shape (<count> <key> <class>), which needs no destructive regeneration, keeps the debt printed, and leaves the existing enforced gate untouched. General rule for choosing a baseline key: key by whatever identity is stable across the kind of edit that legitimately moves the finding (declaration name where a target declaration exists, file path alone where it does not, never a bare repository-wide total, never a line number).
